# Cargar librería
library(qrcode)

# URL de la página
url <- "https://leszavaleta.github.io/semillas-/ANDINA.html"

# Crear QR
qr <- qr_code(url)

# Guardar QR en alta calidad
png(
  filename = "QR_ANDINA.png",
  width = 3000,
  height = 3000,
  res = 300
)

par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plot(qr)

dev.off()

cat("Código QR generado correctamente.")

library(magick)

# ==============================
# 1. CARGAR LAS IMÁGENES
# ==============================

qr <- image_read("QR_ANDINA.png")
logo <- image_read("LOGO INIA.png")


# ==============================
# 2. HACER EL LOGO MÁS PEQUEÑO
# ==============================

logo <- image_resize(logo, "220x220")


# ==============================
# 3. HACER EL LOGO CIRCULAR
# ==============================

# Crear máscara circular
mask <- image_blank(
  width = 220,
  height = 220,
  color = "none"
)

mask <- image_draw(mask)

symbols(
  x = 110,
  y = 110,
  circles = 105,
  bg = "white",
  fg = "white"
)

dev.off()

# Aplicar máscara circular
logo <- image_composite(
  image_blank(220, 220, "white"),
  logo,
  operator = "copy"
)


# ==============================
# 4. CREAR CÍRCULO BLANCO
#    PARA PROTEGER EL QR
# ==============================

fondo <- image_blank(
  width = 280,
  height = 280,
  color = "white"
)


# ==============================
# 5. COLOCAR EL LOGO EN EL CÍRCULO
# ==============================

logo_centro <- image_composite(
  fondo,
  logo,
  gravity = "center"
)


# ==============================
# 6. INSERTAR EN EL CENTRO DEL QR
# ==============================

qr_final <- image_composite(
  qr,
  logo_centro,
  gravity = "center"
)


# ==============================
# 7. GUARDAR EL RESULTADO
# ==============================

image_write(
  qr_final,
  "QR_ANDINA_FINAL.png",
  format = "png"
)


# Mostrar resultado
qr_final




# ==========================================
# CÓDIGO QR - INTI
# ==========================================

install.packages("qrencode")
library(qrencode)

# Enlace de la página web
url <- "https://leszavaleta.github.io/inti/"

# Generar QR
qrencode(
  url,
  mode = "png",
  file = "QR_inti.png",
  size = 1000
)

# Mostrar el QR
knitr::include_graphics("QR_inti.png")
